# KLXPU (KUNLUNXIN XPU) v1-suite ignore list.
#
# Whole files/dirs that hang or wholly fail. Hangs were confirmed above the
# 600s XCCL watchdog (1000s cap); merely-slow files were moved out and now run.
# One path per line, relative to the repo root; blank lines and # comments are
# ignored by the workflow.

# --- BKCL/XCCL single-communicator constraint: distributed runs deadlock
